verdict:
The revised reports are numerically sound: no headline number or verdict is wrong, and I found nothing critical. Every generated table line reproduces verbatim from the result files, and all 60 of my engine runs matched the stored values (max abs difference 2.2e-16). The new result files (sens_A to F and V, hist_extra_dev, night_sharpe) are correct and internally consistent, and the break-even fee line recomputes by hand to the printed values.

One major point must change before the reports are final. The MNQ contract value of 8,355만 원 is labelled "2026-11-10 지수·환율 기준" in all three files, but it is the 2026-10-07 index (31,160.08) times the 2026-10-08 exchange rate (1,340.68). At the last index in the folder (27,937 on 2026-11-09, same rate) one contract is about 7,490만 원, below 8,000만 원. So the statements "8천만 원에서는 0계약" and "약 8,400만 원부터 1계약" hold only at the October index; the pass/fail verdict is unaffected.

The rest is minor: one mislabelled quantity ("연도별 수익률" for a window-CAGR gap), three small rounding or range slips, one sentence in the ≤2014 report that mixes an M figure with a C figure, two over-strong wordings about T5, and a few unsourced counts or estimates.
